assertions_evaluated.text: States the next action is a tool call to AskUserQuestion, not a plain-text/printed question
assertions_evaluated.evidence: Baseline explicitly says: "Right now, before starting the deeper per-component analysis, I would not call any tool... the exact next action is a plain-text checkpoint message — not a tool call."

assertions_evaluated.text: Names the question text 'Found N components. Proceed with full analysis?'
assertions_evaluated.evidence: Baseline's example text is: "Inventory complete: 5 components found (2 skills, 1 sub-agent, 1 command, 1 rule)... Does this list look complete and is this the right depth/focus before I proceed?" -- no match to the required question text.
No discrete option set is named at all; baseline describes an open-ended plain-text question rather than a bounded-choice prompt.

assertions_evaluated.text: States it waits for the user's answer before proceeding to Phase 3
assertions_evaluated.evidence: Baseline is explicitly conditional and includes a non-waiting branch: "if the task was already unambiguous about doing 'in-depth analysis of each', states the plan and moves directly into the first component's analysis without waiting." It does not commit to always waiting for an answer.
